report: Conservative source-fact review passes. The manifest arithmetic matches the supplied primary captures: 157 delivered files, 70 frozen Core members, 69 byte-equal to upstream 8174e529, sole changed crates/mori-core/src/lib.rs, eight ordinary Sherlock module files absent from frozen membership, and 72 selected crate/root changes after 85d825ea. Financial and admission sources are byte-unchanged; that is currentness only, not semantic equivalence. New source_adapter projection is metadata: function, branch, recursion and data support are false, evaluation is false, and backend compile_reported still calls the existing signed or unsigned compiler before constructing the report. Draft moriarty-sherlock-draft/1 functions, lists and trees remain cfg(test), not shipped moriarty/1. Pinned mori-k2 still routes through mori_r1cs::compile_source and differs from the upstream main CLI, which now writes source-projection.json. Root recheck counts cited are byte/source observations, not runtime or proof. Requested author gpt-6.1-sol high was not independently observed. Documentation intake remains limited: broader roadmap and product-contract material was not freshly read, the earlier-missing product contract was not revalidated, and graphify-out/graph.json was absent. Security, cryptography, compatibility and target acceptance are flagged for Opus, unjudged here. All operator, ordinary-selftest and native-authority flags remain false.
